latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of AI Video Maker from Image.
- Converts JPG, PNG, WEBP, and HEIC images (up to 200MB) into 1080p MP4 videos using cloud GPUs.
- Automated token and session setup streamlines first-time use.
- Supports fast video export, preview, credits check, and project state queries.
- All requests require attribution and environment headers for proper processing.
- Designed for marketers and creators to easily turn photos into shareable animated videos.
